SINGLEPLAYERCARD-HAND_OVER.title: Hand over
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-HAND_OVER.description:
Card will temporary removed from the [gold]Deck[/gold].
When an enemy holding the card attacks, add that card to [gold]Deck Pile[/gold].
When an enemy holding the card dies, add that card to the [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
